text.arabic_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

words.gloss_range: restrictive negator in the opening in...illa frame, not conditional
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) opens the ayah by making the first move exclusion: the following in...illa frame strips the prior idol-claim down until only names remain. That opening restriction also answers the verdict of 53:22 and foreshadows the second in...illa frame later in the ayah, where the method of following is likewise restricted to conjecture.

topics.headline: opening restrictive negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by demolishing possible status before naming the reduced predicate.
topics.reason: QAC and local syntax identify {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) with the later exception particle as restrictive negation, and the row set also notes the paired restriction with word 15.

words.gloss_range: independent feminine pronoun resuming the prior packaged claim
words.prose: {{ar:هِىَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}) briefly lets the previously packaged referent stand as the subject before the predicate reduces it to names. The pronoun reaches back through the judgment in 53:22 and the named figures of 53:19-20, so the ayah is unpacking the prior verdict rather than opening a detached subject.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes prior claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject is carried over from the prior claim and then staged for reduction.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun is locally grammatical but referentially depends on the preceding discourse chain.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the first restrictive frame
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge that turns negation into exclusivity. The listener must pass through the exception before reaching the predicate, so the syntax performs stripping and then leaves names as the sole grammatical remainder.

topics.headline: exception hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle does more than deny; it leaves one reduced predicate standing.
topics.reason: The exception particle completes the first restrictive construction and licenses the following predicate as the sole remainder.

words.gloss_range: names as an indefinite predicate under restriction; locally human labels rather than discovered essences
words.root_gloss_range: name/elevation family and possible marking pressure are present as background, narrowed here to unauthenticated labels
words.prose: {{ar:أَسْمَآءٌ}} ({{tr:asmāʾun}}) is the reduced predicate: the idols are identified directly as names, with indefiniteness and broken plural form multiplying labels while withholding substantive status. The same root then immediately returns in the following naming verb, so the line becomes self-deflating: names that you named. The name/elevation and marking associations survive as narrowed pressure here, because the ayah denies any heavenly warrant for the labels; the naming critique also matches the formula in 7:71 and 12:40.

topics.headline: indefinite name deflation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the predicate does not merely say the idols have names; it reduces them to unauthenticated labels.
topics.reason: The word is the nominative predicate of the first restrictive clause and is indefinite under a reduction frame.

topics.headline: name root echo and formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the circular source exposure in the phrase, while the broader root and formula parallels remain subordinate to the local label critique.
topics.reason: The root echo with the next word and the parallels in 7:71 and 12:40 are coherent, but the local sense is narrowed to human naming rather than an active sky/elevation sense.

words.gloss_range: Form II completed human naming with a feminine object suffix referring back to the names/idols
words.root_gloss_range: name/marking/elevation range narrowed to deliberate designation imposed by the addressed group
words.prose: {{ar:سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ}} ({{tr:sammaytumūhā}}) turns the reduced names into an accountable human action: you named them, and the object suffix ties the act back to the same referents just stripped of substance. Form II and the second-person perfect make the naming an imposed, completed deed rather than passive inheritance alone, while the following mention of fathers shows the inherited channel too. The root echo with the previous name-noun makes the phrase circular, and the formula with fathers is echoed in 7:71 and 12:40.

topics.headline: completed human naming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the critique names accountable human agency, not merely a mistaken vocabulary item.
topics.reason: The perfect Form II verb with 2mp subject and object suffix grammatically makes the addressees agents over the labels.

topics.headline: root echo and inherited formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording exposes circular authorization and places the local accusation inside a recurring inherited-naming critique.
topics.reason: The echo and parallels are real, while marking/elevation and sound claims remain secondary to the local act of designation.

words.gloss_range: detached emphatic second-person plural pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:antum}}) repeats the subject already carried in the verb, isolating the addressees as personally accountable namers. The pronoun holds direct-address pressure before the ayah later shifts into third-person characterization, and it also opens the agency pair with the fathers.

topics.headline: emphatic you agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that responsibility is pinned on the present audience before ancestry is added.
topics.reason: QAC marks the pronoun as emphatic after the verb, and the following coordination extends rather than dilutes that agency.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining present addressees and fathers as agents
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not merely add an aside; it joins the present addressees and their fathers under the same naming action. The inherited source of the labels becomes part of the indictment rather than an excuse from it.

topics.headline: coordinated generational agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that present and ancestral agency are syntactically fused under one accusation.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the fathers with the emphatic second-person pronoun as co-agents of the naming verb.

words.gloss_range: your fathers or authoritative predecessors as conjoined co-agents of naming
words.root_gloss_range: father/ancestry range narrowed to inherited precedent, not a refusal-root sense
words.prose: {{ar:ءَابَآؤُكُم}} ({{tr:ābāʾukum}}) turns the naming into an inherited chain: the broken plural and suffix make it your fathers, not ancestry in the abstract. The word is conjoined as a nominative co-agent, so tradition is recast as participation in fabrication. The possible refusal-root pressure is narrowed away; what matters locally is inherited precedent tested against absent proof, a pattern also visible in 7:71 and 12:40.

topics.headline: inherited coagency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ancestry is not allowed to function as authority; it becomes a named source of the false labels.
topics.reason: The local coordination and possessive suffix support inherited coagency, while the alternative refusal-root pressure is only a narrowed background note.

words.gloss_range: negative particle governing the divine sending clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) starts the second dismantling beat by negating the entire claim that God sent any warrant for the names. After human naming has been exposed, the particle pivots to divine non-authorization: the issue is not whether the labels are old, but whether any authority was sent down for them.

topics.headline: negated divine warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the argument move from human source to divine non-authorization.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as negating the verb of sending, and the clause explains the lack of authority for the names.

words.gloss_range: Form IV causative sending down, negated as a completed non-event
words.root_gloss_range: descent/revelation range narrowed to denied divine transmission of warrant
words.prose: {{ar:أَنزَلَ}} ({{tr:anzala}}) uses the revelation-descent verb precisely under negation: no causative sending down by God ever stands behind these labels. The perfect under the negator makes the absence categorical, not merely delayed, and the descent field contrasts with genuine descent language in 53:13 and with the guidance that later arrives in this same ayah.

topics.headline: negated causative descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah denies an actual divine transmission event, not only visible proof in the present.
topics.reason: The Form IV perfect is negated by {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}), and the clause links this non-sending to the absent authority.

topics.headline: descent formula contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that revelation vocabulary is invoked to deny revelation-like authorization for the names.
topics.reason: The descent and formula parallels survive as contrast, but the local action is a negated sending rather than an active revelatory event.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as explicit subject of the negated sending
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field locally focused on unique divine agency and authority
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is the explicit subject of the non-sending. The denial is therefore theological rather than merely evidentiary: the unique divine agent is named inside the clause to say that these human labels have no authorization from God, while the same surah continues to develop divine authority in 53:25 and 53:31.

topics.headline: divine subject of non-sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warrant is denied from the highest possible subject, not from human discovery alone.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as the subject of {{ar:أَنزَلَ}} ({{tr:anzala}}), centering God's non-authorization before the object appears.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus feminine suffix binding the authority denial to the names/idols
words.prose: {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}) keeps the authority denial attached to the exact objects already reduced to names. The bāʾ marks concern or association, and the feminine suffix resumes the earlier referent, so the warrant-word cannot float as a general theological claim; it is about these labels.

topics.headline: attached authority topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the absence of warrant is grammatically bound to the named objects under critique.
topics.reason: The preposition and attached pronoun connect the denial of authority back to the names/idols as the matter under discussion.

words.gloss_range: emphatic min after negation before an indefinite authority noun
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) intensifies the negation before the indefinite warrant noun: not any authority at all. Its normal source or partitive range is narrowed by the negated environment into exhaustive absence, while the double preposition frame tightens the denial around the authority term.

topics.headline: emphatic any min
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar denies even the smallest trace of warrant, not merely a named document.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) as emphatic after negation; source/partitive associations are narrowed by the local negated indefinite construction.

words.gloss_range: authority, warrant, or compelling proof, indefinite under exhaustive negation
words.root_gloss_range: prevailing/authority/proof range active as the denied warrant that would compel assent
words.prose: {{ar:سُلْطَٰنٍ}} ({{tr:sulṭānin}}) names the missing warrant: authority and proof together. Because it is indefinite after negation and emphatic min, the clause leaves no kind, instance, or trace of such warrant for the names. The root's prevailing force matters positively here as what proof would do if it existed; the ayah says no such compelling authorization was sent down, explaining the unjust apportionment from 53:22.

topics.headline: no authority at all
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one word removes both divine authorization and evidentiary proof.
topics.reason: The indefinite noun under negation and emphatic {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) supports exhaustive denial, while V4 sense evidence supports the authority/proof range.

words.gloss_range: second restrictive negator, governing the following imperfect verb
words.prose: The second {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) begins a matching restrictive frame, now over the followers' ongoing practice. The first frame reduced the idols to names; this one reduces the method to conjecture and desire, and the exact conjecture-following motif returns in 53:28.

topics.headline: second restrictive frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's paired architecture: false objects first, false method second.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the second particle as restrictive negation, and the following imperfect makes the restricted action ongoing.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII imperfect following as deliberate ongoing adherence
words.root_gloss_range: following/pursuit/adherence range narrowed to epistemic allegiance to conjecture and desire
words.prose: {{ar:يَتَّبِعُونَ}} ({{tr:yattabiʿūna}}) makes their error an ongoing practice of chosen adherence, not a single inherited accident. Form VIII selects adopted allegiance to conjecture and desire, while the third-person form turns direct accusation into public characterization; the accepted tattabiʿūna reading keeps the direct-address pressure alive without changing the restricted object. The phrase also contrasts with the surah's denial that the Prophet speaks from desire in 53:3 and recurs as a diagnostic in 53:28.

topics.headline: deliberate ongoing following
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the indictment targets an adopted method of allegiance, not passive exposure to inherited claims.
topics.reason: The imperfect Form VIII verb under restriction supports ongoing deliberate adherence to the two objects that follow.

topics.headline: qiraat and surah contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that discourse stance can shift between report and direct confrontation while culpable following remains constant.
topics.reason: The canonical variant and same-surah echoes illuminate stance and recurrence, but they do not override the local third-person QAC parse.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the second restrictive frame
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) closes the second restriction and leaves conjecture as the first named object of following. The structure then expands by coordination, so conjecture is not alone but becomes the core epistemic residue before desire is added.

topics.headline: second exception hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the grammar first isolates conjecture and then lets desire join it under the same following.
topics.reason: The exception particle links the negated imperfect to the object that follows and prepares the coordinated expansion.

words.gloss_range: the identifiable conjecture followed as object; locally pejorative opinion without proof
words.root_gloss_range: suspicion-to-near-certainty range narrowed by no authority, desire, and guidance contrast
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظَّنَّ}} ({{tr:al-ẓanna}}) is the followed object, not a background mental state. Its definiteness makes the conjecture identifiable in this controversy, while the root's wider range is narrowed by the absence of authority and its pairing with desire into pejorative opinion without proof. The word forms one half of the error pair: conjecture supplies the weak epistemic track, and what the selves desire supplies the appetitive pull; the same theme returns in 53:28.

topics.headline: identified conjecture object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that conjecture has become the object they follow in place of proof and guidance.
topics.reason: The gerund is accusative as the object of following; broader senses of the root are narrowed by the local no-authority and desire context.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating desired content with conjecture under the same following verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds desire to conjecture as a second followed object without starting a new action. The ayah refuses to split bad evidence from bad appetite; both are gathered under the same verb of following.

topics.headline: conjecture desire coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that epistemic failure and appetite are one coordinated method here.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the free-relative desire clause with {{ar:ٱلظَّنَّ}} ({{tr:al-ẓanna}}) as objects of the same following verb.

words.gloss_range: headless relative pronoun making desired content a substantive followed object
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is relative here, not negative: it turns the clause into the open object, what the selves desire. Because the desired content is left unspecified, appetite appears as a mechanism that can keep supplying objects, in contrast with the definite final guidance.

topics.headline: open relative desire object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names the desiring mechanism while leaving its contents open-ended.
topics.reason: The following verb requires an object and QAC identifies the word as a relative pronoun introducing the second followed object.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect desire, with falling-root pressure and internal inclination
words.root_gloss_range: desire/falling range active as downward appetite, narrowed away from caused hurling
words.prose: {{ar:تَهْوَى}} ({{tr:tahwā}}) makes desire active in the clause. The root's falling image gives the wanting a downward pull, so the error is not only weak inference but appetite-driven descent away from guidance; Form I keeps that inclination internal rather than externally hurled. The feminine singular before the plural subject follows normal pre-subject agreement while still allowing the desire to be heard across individual selves, and the surah-local root arc links the ordered descent of 53:1 and the denial of prophetic desire in 53:3 with this appetite-driven falling.

topics.headline: desire as downward inclination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices desire as an internal downward pull, not just a neutral preference.
topics.reason: The h-w-y desire/falling pathway is locally supported, while Form I and syntax narrow it to internal inclination rather than external hurling.

words.gloss_range: the selves as definite plural subject of desire, locally appetitive selves
words.root_gloss_range: self/breath/person/appetite range narrowed by desire into the desiring self
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَنفُسُ}} ({{tr:al-anfusu}}) names the internal agents of desire. The word could range across person, self, breath, and appetite, but as the subject of the desire verb it narrows to the appetitive self; the broken plural distributes that pull across many selves rather than making it a single abstraction. The same-surah recurrence in 53:32 links the desiring self here with later self-justification.

topics.headline: appetitive selves as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that desire is internalized in the selves themselves, not assigned only to external idols.
topics.reason: The definite plural noun is the subject of the desire verb, narrowing the broader nafs range to appetitive selves in this clause.

words.gloss_range: final conjunction as contrastive, circumstantial, or resumptive pivot into the guidance clause
words.prose: The final {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from the negative sequence to affirmation. On the circumstantial reading, it says their following occurs while guidance has already come; on the resumptive reading, it launches a fresh corrective assertion. Either way, the conjunction leads into stacked laqad emphasis and turns the ayah from names, no authority, and conjecture into the settled fact of arrived guidance.

topics.headline: contrastive guidance pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause is both a contrast to their following and a settled rebuttal to it.
topics.reason: QAC allows circumstantial or resumptive force; both readings support a contrastive pivot into emphatic guidance arrival.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lam prefixed to qad in the final assertion
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) raises the final clause from report to emphatic verification. Fused with qad, it makes the assertion reach the verb already marked as confirmed, so the guidance claim is shaped for a resistant audience.

topics.headline: lam emphatic confirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final arrival claim is grammatically intensified before the verb appears.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as emphatic, and the local fusion with {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) creates the laqad confirmation stack.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle with perfect verb, marking realized occurrence
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) with the perfect verb selects verified occurrence, not possibility or approximation. It gives the final beat completed temporal shape: guidance has already arrived, while their following remains the ongoing pattern under critique.

topics.headline: qad realized arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is presented as an already realized fact, not a future possibility.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) with the perfect as a certainty particle marking completed realized action.

words.gloss_range: perfect arrival verb with recipient suffix, asserting guidance reached them
words.root_gloss_range: coming/arrival range focused on completed arrival at the implicated recipients
words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَهُم}} ({{tr:jāʾahum}}) makes the counter-fact recipient-specific: guidance did not merely exist somewhere, it reached them. The perfect under laqad marks completed arrival, and the suffix binds the event to the same group described as following conjecture. Structurally, the verb reverses the prior denials, moving from empty names, no warrant, and conjecture to an arrived alternative.

topics.headline: recipient specific arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance has reached the very people whose ongoing following is being indicted.
topics.reason: The perfect arrival verb with attached object suffix and preceding laqad asserts completed delivery to the implicated recipients.

words.gloss_range: source preposition governing their Lord in the guidance-arrival clause
words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) now marks source rather than emphatic absence. It routes the arrived guidance from their Lord before the final word names guidance, so the closure lands with origin already secured and distinguished from conjecture or the selves.

topics.headline: source of guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final guidance is sourced before it is named.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the preposition as source-marking in the final arrival clause, governing the Lord phrase.

words.gloss_range: their Lord as relational source of guidance
words.root_gloss_range: lord/master/nurturer/developer range active as relational, nurturing authority
words.prose: {{ar:رَّبِّهِمُ}} ({{tr:rabbihimu}}) makes the source relational: guidance came from their Lord, not from an abstract authority detached from them. The suffix sharpens the irony because the one related to them as Lord is the source of guidance they bypass. The r-b-b nurturing-development range gives the guidance the feel of provision from the one responsible for their formation, and the phrase also answers the earlier denial of sent-down authority by naming the warranted divine source before the ayah closes on guidance.

topics.headline: their Lord as guidance source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the guidance they ignore comes from their own Lord.
topics.reason: The genitive source complement with possessive suffix supports relational divine source, and the local field links Lord, arrival, and guidance.

words.gloss_range: the definite guidance as the arriving subject and ayah-final counter-term
words.root_gloss_range: guiding/showing-the-way range active as divinely sourced direction, not coercive force
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:al-hudā}}) is the grammatical subject that came to them, so guidance is not merely available in the background; it actively arrives. Its definiteness makes it the positive epistemic counter-term to definite conjecture: conjecture is followed without warrant, while guidance comes from their Lord. As the final word, it answers both the empty names at the opening and the conjecture-desire method in the middle, and the h-d-y thread continues in 53:30 from arrival of guidance to assessment of who is guided.

topics.headline: arrived guidance counterterm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes by naming the real, divinely sourced alternative to both empty labels and conjecture.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the definite gerund as subject of the arrival verb, and the local discourse contrasts guidance with conjecture and empty names.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'names / you named them / your fathers / no sending-down / no authority.'
baseline_models.mechanism: A designation is raised into public notice, transmitted through parental nurture, and then treated as though transmission supplied transcendent warrant. The verse breaks that production pipeline at its last link: inherited recognizability is not an overpowering proof sent by God.

activation_trace.role: Name as raised designation supplies the public label that the community can circulate and mistake for a warranted referent.
Parental nurture supplies the intergenerational channel by which the designation acquires familiarity and durability.
Bringing or sending down supplies the absent source event: no higher authorization accompanied the inherited label.
Overpowering proof supplies the evidentiary force that mere repetition and ancestry cannot manufacture.

changed_reading.before: The verse says that the alleged deities are merely false names.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes a social production line: designation plus inheritance can create stable recognition, but neither recognition nor age crosses the missing-warrant gap.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed motions in 'they follow conjecture and what selves incline toward' versus 'guidance came to them from their Lord.'
baseline_models.mechanism: One trajectory tracks step by step behind an uncertain projection and is bent by inner inclination; the other arrives from outside that recursive circuit and gently supplies a way. The contrast is dynamic rather than merely a list of good and bad information sources.

activation_trace.role: Stepwise tracking makes following a path-dependent process in which each inherited step licenses the next.
Uncertain supposition supplies the unstable object being tracked rather than a fixed destination.
The self's inclination supplies the internal force that bends the tracking path toward what is already wanted.
Falling into an abyss gives that inclination an exploratory downward vector and a possible terminal consequence.
Inner thought and hidden intent locate the bending force within the interpretive self, not in the named object.
Arrival supplies a completed encounter that interrupts recursive pursuit rather than asking the pursuer to project a target.
Gentle guidance toward a way supplies the alternative orientation made available by that arrival.

changed_reading.before: Conjecture and desire are bad grounds of belief, while guidance is the good ground.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagrams rival motion systems: recursive tracking follows an internally tilted projection, while arrived guidance reorients the traveler from beyond that loop.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The explicit contrast between 'your fathers' and 'their Lord,' with guidance presented as something brought to them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah places two formative relations around the hearer. Ancestral nurture hands down a vocabulary; lordly nurture repairs, completes, and presents guidance as a gift. The dispute therefore concerns which relation is allowed to form perception, not simply which proposition wins.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and parental nurture supply the horizontal formative relation that transmits the names.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the competing formation attributed to their Lord.
Bringing or presenting something makes guidance a delivered provision rather than an inherited verbal possession.
A gracious gift to someone close gives the delivered guidance a relational, non-coercive mode of formation.

changed_reading.before: Ancestral custom is rejected in favor of divine guidance.
changed_reading.after: Two pedagogies coexist in the ayah: inherited naming forms recognition by repetition, while lordly care forms direction by a newly presented gift.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Naming, the void/desire of the selves, and the denied sharp force of sultan occur in one causal sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Names are voiced by selves whose breath and inward inclination can fill a referential void; a forceful tongue can then make those utterances sound authoritative. The denied sultan prevents vocal force from being confused with proof.

activation_trace.role: Raised designation supplies the uttered unit that is elevated into communal notice.
Air, void, and hollowness supply the empty space that self-generated speech appears to fill.
Breath leaving the body supplies the material carrier by which inward inclination becomes a circulating name.
A forceful sharp tongue supplies the counterfeit pressure that can make voiced labels feel binding despite absent proof.

changed_reading.before: The false names express subjective desire.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the ayah traces a pneumatic counterfeit: inward tilt becomes breath, breath becomes elevated naming, and rhetorical force impersonates authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah-wide repetition gives hawa a gravitational field: a star falls, speech is denied derivation from self-inclination, the focus selves incline, and the overturned settlement is cast down. Fixed truth provides the counterweight. Desire thus becomes both an epistemic bias and a downward causal vector.

activation_trace.role: Inclination of the self anchors the ordinary focus sense while remaining open to the repeated root's spatial activation.
Falling into a depth supplies the opening downward motion that later desire can inherit as a vector.
Self-inclination as a denied speech source turns the spatial vector into an epistemic source test.
Casting down into a fall supplies a destructive endpoint for the inclination trajectory.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the stable alternative that conjecture cannot replace.

structural_cues: The same root frames the surah at 53:1, reappears as a speech-source denial at 53:3, occupies the focus at 53:23, and returns in causative downward motion at 53:53.
The focus places this root between conjecture-following and guidance that has already arrived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root across falling, speech-source, desire, and overthrow; I infer a repeated downward causal vector; alternatively, each occurrence may retain its local idiom without forming one extended motion model.

changed_reading.before: The selves merely prefer what supports inherited beliefs.
changed_reading.after: Their preference has gravity: it bends inquiry downward from uncertain tracking toward self-overthrow, while arrived guidance offers a stable orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context makes both false naming and revelation look like inscription or marking, so the ayah is not anti-sign. It distinguishes a community-applied identifying mark from an inscription whose source imparts knowledge and whose trace leads beyond itself to the thing.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark makes human naming materially effective at recognition even when it lacks divine warrant.
Writing and engraving supply a contrasting source-backed inscription rather than an inherited social brand.
A distinguishing trace that guides to its object supplies the criterion for a sign that successfully leads beyond itself.

structural_cues: Revelation is introduced before the focus as repeated wahi, while 53:28 immediately restates the conjecture problem as absence of knowledge.
The focus denies what was sent down with the names, not the bare use of names.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marking, inscription, and knowledge-as-guiding-trace branches; I infer that provenance separates valid from invalid signs; alternatively, the inscription branch may remain a material analogy rather than a discourse-level contrast.

changed_reading.before: Names are empty, whereas revelation supplies content.
changed_reading.after: Names and revelation can both mark; the decisive question is whether the mark has a source-backed path to knowledge or merely reproduces communal recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding unequal allocation, the later feminizing names for angels, and the later creation of paired sexes turn naming into a distributive act. A label does not only posit a referent; it allocates gender, kinship, prestige, and ownership while hiding that allocation behind grammar.

activation_trace.role: Raised designation anchors naming as the operation whose social effects the surrounding allocation exposes.
Separating and assigning a share supplies the distributive operation performed immediately before the focus names are challenged.
A deficient unjust division supplies the evaluative diagnosis of the naming-backed allocation.
Naming as raised designation repeats the focus operation specifically in the assignment of femininity to angels.
Bringing creation into existence distinguishes divine production of sexed beings from human assignment of divine kinship.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies an actual created relation against which projected classifications are measured.

structural_cues: The focus follows the male/female allocation and the judgment that its division is deficient and unjust.
53:27 repeats naming in a feminine classification, while 53:45 locates paired sexual creation with God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allocation, injustice, repeated sex-naming, and created pairing; I infer that labels enact a hierarchy and kinship claim; alternatively, the sequence may target only argumentative inconsistency without generalizing naming into social distribution.

changed_reading.before: The divine names fail because their referents do not exist as claimed.
changed_reading.after: The names also do political work: they distribute gendered status and divine kinship, converting a desired allocation into an apparently natural taxonomy.

context_deltas.mechanism: One context root spans a wish pictured by the heart and seminal material from which a creature is apportioned. Against that span, focus naming appears able to picture and project an ontology but unable to generate one; actual emergence belongs to measured creation rather than desire's verbal image.

activation_trace.role: Inclination of the self anchors the projective appetite that wants its designation to become reality.
Raised designation supplies the verbal image through which the wanted ontology is socially projected.
A wish pictured by the heart supplies the immediate context's model of projective possession.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies the controlled generative process absent from wishful naming.
Seminal material from which creation is apportioned supplies the concrete generative pole opposed to heart-imaged wishing.

structural_cues: The question immediately after the focus asks whether the human has whatever he wishes.
The same root returns in the creation sequence at 53:46 after God creates the pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root for wished imagery and generative material plus a creation-measure branch; I infer a projection-versus-generation contrast; alternatively, the repeated root may function as wordplay without assigning a causal theory of naming.

changed_reading.before: Desire makes people believe the names they inherited.
changed_reading.after: Desire can picture and name a world but cannot beget it: the ayah separates verbal wish-production from measured material generation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prohibition on declaring selves pure reveals a general self-certifying operation: the same inner self that inclines can issue an evaluative label and then receive that label as evidence. Focus idol naming is one outward instance of this closed authorization loop.

activation_trace.role: Raised designation anchors the act by which an evaluation becomes a publicly available identity.
Inner thought and intent locate both desire and the first audience for the self-issued designation.
Purity and soundness supply the evaluative content that selves are forbidden to certify for themselves.
The thing itself or self supplies the reflexive target that both assigns and benefits from the certification.

structural_cues: 53:32 forbids self-purification and twice contrasts human self-assessment with the Lord's knowing.
The focus already joins naming to what selves incline toward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-inclination and a later ban on self-attributed purity; I infer that evaluative naming can close an authorization loop; alternatively, self-praise may be an ethical parallel rather than an explanation of idol naming.

changed_reading.before: The ayah condemns a special set of inherited cult names.
changed_reading.after: It also diagnoses self-certification: desire emits a label, the self treats its own label as evidence, and missing external warrant disappears from view.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later individual burden and earned striving revise the ancestry clause. Fathers can transmit names, but neither evidentiary burden nor accountable effort transfers with them. The focus exposes provenance without making descendants guilty merely by association or ancestors authoritative merely by priority.

activation_trace.role: Parental nurture supplies real transmission while leaving open whether authority or liability can travel through that relation.
Overpowering proof names the evidentiary burden that inherited naming fails to discharge.
A heavy carried burden supplies the non-transferable liability later stated for each bearer.
Work and earning supply the person's own accountable contribution in place of borrowed ancestral standing.

structural_cues: The focus attributes coinage jointly to the hearers and their fathers but attributes the absence of warrant to the names themselves.
53:38-40 separates each person's burden and striving from every other's.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ancestral transmission followed by non-transferable burden and personal striving; I infer that inherited priority transfers neither proof nor blame automatically; alternatively, the later rules may concern judgment only and not epistemic warrant.

changed_reading.before: Mentioning the fathers simply condemns ancestral imitation.
changed_reading.after: The ancestry clause audits provenance: inheritance explains persistence but cannot transfer proof, and personal accountability prevents the critique from becoming inherited guilt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later assertion that God is Lord of al-Shi'ra presents a specific transferred name with a real celestial referent while subordinating that referent to lordship. This blocks a nominalist reading: the fault is not naming but elevating a name-bearing sign into autonomous divine authority.

activation_trace.role: Name as raised designation anchors the focus critique while allowing that some designations can genuinely pick out a thing.
Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the relation that keeps a named referent from becoming an autonomous power.
A specifically transferred proper name supplies the later named celestial object whose referential success does not confer divinity.

structural_cues: 53:49 predicates lordship over al-Shi'ra, a named celestial referent.
The focus pairs empty divine authorization with naming, not with reference as such.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later proper-name branch under explicit lordship; I infer that the focus criticizes unauthorized deification rather than naming itself; alternatively, 53:49 may target one star cult without articulating a general semiotic rule.

changed_reading.before: Calling the idols 'only names' implies that names are intrinsically empty.
changed_reading.after: A name may successfully identify a star; emptiness begins when designation is inflated into independent lordship without warrant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence tests authority operationally. A fabricated name cannot uncover the approaching reality or redirect a body; guidance from the Lord culminates in bowed, obedient orientation toward God. Epistemic warrant and enacted allegiance become two phases of one reorientation.

strongest_changes: The focus became a causal account of how designation and ancestry create durable recognition without crossing the missing-warrant gap.
Repeated H-W-Y changed self-desire into a downward motion system spanning falling, speech-source, inclination, and overthrow.
The gender sequence changed naming into an act that distributes status and kinship rather than merely attaching words to imaginary beings.
The named star under lordship showed that the ayah is not anti-name: it opposes designation inflated into autonomous authority.
summary.what_was_special: The focus holds several mechanisms at once: semiotic manufacture, rival trajectories, competing formative relations, distributive classification, and embodied reorientation. Split-root branches added live marking, toxic-entry, lighting, and misreception models without displacing the dominant readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The WSM, SMM, and HDD activations are packet-authorized structural probes but remain too branch-distant to present as lexical senses.
The repeated H-W-Y sequence strongly supports a gravity model, though local idiom may account for some recurrence without one intended extended metaphor.
The distributive and self-certification readings are causally coherent, but their extension beyond the immediate polemic remains abductive rather than explicit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Designation without warrant.** The doubled س م و B005 supplies names as raised designations; ن ز ل B002 supplies sending down; س ل ط B002 supplies overpowering proof. The ayah explicitly gives the labels a human/ancestral source and denies a descending warrant. I infer that a name acquires legitimate religious force only through authorized evidence; the idols read as verbally elevated but ontologically unsupported.
2. **An inherited tracking system.** ء ب و B001 supplies parental nurture; ت ب ع B001/B003 supplies following and stepwise tracking. The sequence from “you and your fathers” to “they follow” makes genealogy function as a path. I infer that inherited familiarity can substitute for examination; the ayah reads as a diagnosis of lineage-based epistemic momentum.
3. **Weak indication pulled by inner desire.** ظ ن ن B003 supplies uncertain supposition; ه و ي B004 desire; ن ف س B013 hidden intent. Their coordination gives conjecture a motivational partner. I infer that desire selects which weak indications to follow; the ayah reads not as ignorance alone but as motivated inference.
4. **Guidance arrives as a different causal chain.** ج ي ء B001 supplies arrival; ر ب ب B002 supplies staged nurture; ه د ي B001 supplies gentle guidance toward truth. Against inherited naming and appetite, the final clause presents guidance as something that comes from formative lordship. I infer that externally arriving direction can interrupt self-reinforcing tradition; the ayah reads as two competing production systems for belief.
5. **Authority is neither force nor mere naming.** س ل ط B001 supplies coercive force, B002 proof, and B003 delegated authority. The negative *min sulṭān* permits these distinct scopes. I infer that the names lack evidentiary warrant, authorized rule, and any power capable of establishing their claim; the ayah preserves all three deficits rather than merging them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:27 repeats doubled naming and 53:28 immediately repeats conjectural following, separating the long ayah's mechanisms into two later diagnostics. 53:49 then supplies the surprising positive case: a proper celestial name can remain valid when placed under lordship rather than made a rival.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Raised labels without a descending warrant.** The doubled naming activates `س م و B005`, a name as a raised designation; `ن ز ل B002` supplies bringing down or sending down; and `س ل ط B002` supplies overpowering proof. The ayah itself sets human and ancestral raising of names against the absence of any sent authority, while 53:18 supplies genuine source-bearing signs and 53:26 supplies actual permission. The packet gives labels, descent, proof, signs, and authorization; I infer the arrow source-authorized descent -> valid designation, whose absence leaves only elevated labels. The fixed ayah reads as a vertical provenance test for ontology.

2. **A self-reinforcing pursuit substitutes for knowledge.** `ت ب ع B003` supplies stepwise tracking, `ظ ن ن B003` uncertain supposition, `ه و ي B004` self-inclination, and `ن ف س B013` inner thought or hidden intent. The sequence moves from following to supposition to what inner selves incline toward, then contrasts that loop with the arrival (`ج ي ء B001`, coming and arrival) of gentle guidance (`ه د ي B001`). The packet supplies each node; I infer the directional arrow inner preference -> selective supposition -> repeated tracking. The ayah therefore reads as a causal genealogy of belief maintenance, not merely a list of three faults.

3. **Guidance arrives but does not coerce.** `ه د ي B001` supplies gentle guidance toward a way or truth, while `س ل ط B001` supplies coercive force let loose. Their structural separation matters: no coercive authority descended with the names, yet guidance did come. The packet supplies non-coercive guidance and absent coercive proof; I infer that arrival offers a route without mechanically overriding desire. The fixed ending reads as a correction of provenance that leaves the prior following mechanism visible.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:24-28 completed the mechanism: wish seeks self-decree, ownership and permission block it, naming repeats, and explicit lack of knowledge exposes the resulting conjecture loop.

baseline.text: Onlar, sizin ve atalarınızın verdiği adlardan başka bir şey değildir. Allah onlar hakkında hiçbir kanıt indirmedi. Onlar yalnızca zanna ve nefislerin arzuladığı şeye uyuyorlar. Oysa Rablerinden kendilerine doğru yol gelmiştir.

findings.text: İnsanların yukarı kaldırdığı adlarla Allah'tan inen kanıtın karşıt yönleri, dini adlandırma için dikey bir yetki sınaması kurar.
Atalardan devralınan tanışıklık, adları adım adım izlenen bir yola çevirerek incelemenin yerine soy sürekliliğini koyar.
Nefsin eğilimi hangi zayıf işaretlerin seçilip tekrar izleneceğini belirleyerek zannı güdümlü bir çıkarıma dönüştürür.
Dışarıdan gelen doğru yol, kendi kendini besleyen ad, arzu ve takip döngüsünü keserek inancın başka bir yoldan oluşmasını mümkün kılar.
Kanıtın inmemesi, bu adların iddialarını gerçek kılacak zorlayıcı bir güce sahip olmadığını da gösterir.
Bu adlara dini alanda yönetme yetkisi de devredilmemiştir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi dalın çekirdeğini hem somut yükselme hem de kişinin değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesi olarak açıkça kurar. Bakışın yukarı yönelmesi bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel yükselmeyi kapsar; gök, ad, av ve yarışma dallarının kalıplaşmış anlamlarını kendi içine almaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel yükselme çekirdeği ile bakış, toplumsal konum ve gururlu duruşa bağlı özel kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin fiziksel olarak yukarı çıkması veya bir kişinin toplumsal değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesidir. Bakışın yukarı kaldırılması bu hareketin özel bir uygulamasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey bulunduğu düzeyden yukarı çıkar veya yüksek duruma gelir.
Bir kişinin değeri, saygınlığı ya da toplumdaki yeri yükselir.
Bakış bir şeye doğru yukarı kaldırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükselmeyi dalın ortak çekirdeği sayar; bunu fiziksel yükselişe, bakışın kaldırılmasına ve değerli kişinin toplumdaki yerinin yükselmesine uygular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın somut yükselme çekirdeğini ve kişinin değer ya da saygınlık bakımından yükselmesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı çıkma ile toplumsal değer artışını aynı yükselme ekseninde korur.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel yukarı çıkma hareketini doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin toplumdaki değerinin veya konumunun yükseldiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi üstte bulunup örten şey çekirdeğini gök ve tavanla verir; bulut, yağmur, bitki, atın sırtı ve her şeyin üst yanı kullanımlarını da açıkça ekler. Dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ona bağlı aktarmaları doğru ayırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üstte olma ve örtme çekirdeği önde tutulur; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımları genel yükselme anlamına dönüştürülmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gök ve üst örtü çekirdeği ile bulut, yağmur, bitki, at sırtı ve genel üst yan kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan ve onu örten gök, tavan ya da genel üst yandır. Bu ad buluta, yukarıdan gelen yağmura, yağmurla çıkan veya yükselen bitkiye ve atın sırtına da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin üzerinde yükselen ve onu örten gök, tavan veya üst yan anlatılır.
Üstte bulunan ve örten bulut aynı adla anılır.
Yukarıdaki kaynağından gelen yağmur aynı adla anılır.
Yağmurdan çıkan veya yerden yükselen bitkiye aynı ad aktarılır.
Atın sırtı ve genel olarak bir şeyin en üst yanı bu yüksek üst yüzey kapsamında adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gök, tavan ve üst yan anlamlarını yüksekte bulunup örtme çekirdeğinde birleştirir; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımlarını buna bağlı uzantılar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: üstteki gök veya örtü ve buna bağlı üstten gelen ya da üstte bulunan şeyler
concept_gloss.applicability: Gök ve tavan çekirdeğinin yanı sıra bulut, yağmur, bitki ve bir şeyin üst yanı için belirtilen bağlı kullanımları kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Üstte bulunma ve örtme çekirdeğiyle ona bağlı uzantıları korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan, yükselen ve onu örten üst alan veya yapı kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üstte bulunma ve örtme çekirdeğini doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gökteki bulut ya da yukarıdan gelen yağmur için aktarmalı kullanım gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut ve ondan geldiği düşünülen yağmur uzantılarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yağmurun ürünü veya yerden yükselen bitki için kullanılan özel aktarımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin yağmurla veya yükselmesiyle kurulan bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Atın sırtı dahil bir nesnenin en üst yüzeyi ya da yanı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: At sırtını ve genel üst yüzey anlamını korur.

yağmurla çıkan veya yerden yükselen bitki

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi adı bir şeyi tanıtan gösterge olarak tanımlar; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve aynı adı ya da niteliği hak eden denklik anlamlarını açıkça bağlar. Adın anılmayı yükselttiğine ilişkin açıklama anlamın tarihsel gerekçesi olarak tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilsel adlandırma ve adla kurulan denklikle sınırlıdır; gök ya da fiziksel yükselme anlamı yalnız açıklayıcı köken bağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad çekirdeği; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad, bu adı verme veya edinme ve başka biriyle aynı adı taşıma ilişkisidir. Ayrıca aynı adı ya da niteliği hak edecek ölçüde denk olmayı anlatır; kaynaklar adlandırmayı anılmayı yükseltme düşüncesiyle açıklar.

facets.statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
Bir kişi, aynı adı veya niteliği hak edecek ölçüde başkasının dengi sayılır.
Kaynaklar adın kökenini, adı verilen şeyin anılmasını yükseltmesi ve onu belirgin kılmasıyla açıklar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı bir varlığı tanıtan unsur sayar; ad verme, ad edinme, aynı adı taşıma ve ada ya da niteliğe layık denklik anlamlarını birleştirir. Adın anılmayı yükselttiği yönündeki köken açıklamasını da paylaşır.

concept_gloss.text: ad, adlandırma ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad çekirdeğini, ad verme ve edinme işlemlerini, adaşlığı ve adı hak eden denkliği birlikte kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi çekirdeği bir topluluğun ıssız arazilere av için çıkması olarak verir; avcı adı, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği çorap da aynı av alanına bağlıdır. Dal çerçevesi bu bağı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel gitmeyi değil, av amacıyla açık ve ıssız araziye çıkmayı ve yalnız buna bağlı kişi, arama ve araç kullanımlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Av için araziye çıkma çekirdeği; avcı, av hayvanını arama ve avcı çorabı bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun avlanmak için kır ve çöl gibi ıssız arazilere çıkmasıdır. Avcılar, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği koruyucu çorap bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluk avlanmak amacıyla kır veya çöl gibi ıssız araziye çıkar.
Bu amaçla araziye çıkan kişiler avcı adıyla anılır.
Av hayvanını bulup avlamak üzere arama eylemi aynı alana bağlıdır.
Avcının sıcak zeminde hayvan beklerken ayağını korumak için giydiği çorap adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar av için kır ve çöl arazisine çıkmayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; avcı adını, av hayvanını aramayı ve sıcak zeminde bekleyen avcının koruyucu çorabını buna bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve birbirine karşı koymayı aynı dalda birleştirir; kimsenin yarışamadığı kişi ifadesi de bu karşılaştırma eksenine dayanır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı yarışma ve denk gelme alanındadır; yalnız aynı adı taşıma ya da genel üstünlük bu karşılıklılık olmadan dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı yarışma çekirdeği, övünerek boy ölçüşme, karşı koyma ve kimsenin yarışamaması bildiren özel biçimlerle karıştırılmadan verilir.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın üstün gelmek için birbiriyle yarışması, övünerek boy ölçüşmesi veya birbirine karşı koymasıdır. Bir kimseyle hiç kimsenin yarışamaması, onun bu karşılaştırmada erişilemez üstünlüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İki veya daha çok taraf üstün gelmek için karşılıklı olarak yarışır.
Taraflar sahip oldukları üstünlüklerle övünerek birbirleriyle boy ölçüşür.
Taraflardan biri ötekine karşı koyar, onunla aynı düzeye gelmeye veya onu geçmeye çalışır.
Kimsenin bir kişiyle yarışamaması, o kişinin erişilemez ölçüde üstün olduğunu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve karşı koyma anlamlarını birleştirir; bir kişiyle kimsenin yarışamaması ifadesini onun üstünlüğünün sonucu olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da hayvanı tanınmasını sağlayacak görünür bir izle işaretleme eylemini, bu eylemin bıraktığı izi ve işaretlemede kullanılan kızgın aracı birlikte verir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

Özellikle hayvanlara bu izi koymak için kullanılan kızgın işaretleme aracı da bu dala bağlıdır.
